# Tool reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-tools-doc.mjs — do not edit by hand. -->

Every tool accepts `property` as a numeric ID, `properties/ID` or display name; it can be omitted when `GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY` is set.

## `list_accounts`

List the Google Analytics accounts the authenticated user can access, each with its GA4 properties (ID and display name). Start here when you don't know the property ID.

## `list_properties`

List accessible GA4 properties as a flat list. Optionally filter by account (ID or name) or by a case-insensitive search on the property name.

| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                                              |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| `account` | string |          | Account ID or (partial) account display name.            |
| `search`  | string |          | Case-insensitive substring of the property display name. |

## `get_property`

Get a GA4 property's settings: time zone, currency, industry category, service level (Standard/360), creation time and parent account.

| Parameter  | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property` | string |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |

## `list_data_streams`

List a property's data streams (web, Android, iOS) including measurement IDs (G-XXXX), website URLs and app IDs.

| Parameter  | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property` | string |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |

## `get_metadata`

List the dimension and metric API names available for reports on a property, including the property's custom dimensions/metrics (e.g. customEvent:plan_type). Use `search` to narrow the list — the full catalogue is large.

| Parameter             | Type                               | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`            | string                             |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |
| `kind`                | `all` \| `dimensions` \| `metrics` |          | Default: `"all"`.                                                                                                                                       |
| `search`              | string                             |          | Case-insensitive match on name, UI name, category or description, e.g. "session", "ecommerce".                                                          |
| `customOnly`          | boolean                            |          | Only return the property's custom definitions. Default: `false`.                                                                                        |
| `includeDescriptions` | boolean                            |          | Default: `false`.                                                                                                                                       |

## `check_compatibility`

Check whether a set of dimensions and metrics can be used together in one report. Returns the incompatible fields (if any). Use before run_report when mixing scopes, e.g. item-scoped with session-scoped fields.

| Parameter         | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`        | string   |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `dimensions`      | string[] |          | Default: `[]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `metrics`         | string[] |          | Default: `[]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `dimensionFilter` | object   |          | A GA4 Data API FilterExpression object. Examples:<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"country","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"United States"}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"eventName","inListFilter":{"values":["purchase","sign_up"]}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"sessions","numericFilter":{"operation":"GREATER_THAN","value":{"int64Value":"100"}}}}<br>{"andGroup":{"expressions":[<expr>,<expr>]}} · {"orGroup":{"expressions":[...]}} · {"notExpression":<expr>}<br>stringFilter.matchType: EXACT \| BEGINS_WITH \| ENDS_WITH \| CONTAINS \| FULL_REGEXP \| PARTIAL_REGEXP. Use dimension fields in dimensionFilter and metric fields in metricFilter. |
| `metricFilter`    | object   |          | A GA4 Data API FilterExpression object. Examples:<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"country","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"United States"}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"eventName","inListFilter":{"values":["purchase","sign_up"]}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"sessions","numericFilter":{"operation":"GREATER_THAN","value":{"int64Value":"100"}}}}<br>{"andGroup":{"expressions":[<expr>,<expr>]}} · {"orGroup":{"expressions":[...]}} · {"notExpression":<expr>}<br>stringFilter.matchType: EXACT \| BEGINS_WITH \| ENDS_WITH \| CONTAINS \| FULL_REGEXP \| PARTIAL_REGEXP. Use dimension fields in dimensionFilter and metric fields in metricFilter. |

## `run_report`

Run a Google Analytics 4 report (Data API runReport). Returns rows as JSON records keyed by dimension/metric name. Examples: traffic by channel, top pages, conversions by campaign, revenue by country, daily trend with dimension "date".

| Parameter         | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`        | string   |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `dimensions`      | string[] |          | Dimension API names, e.g. ["date","sessionDefaultChannelGroup"]. Use get_metadata to discover names. Default: `[]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `metrics`         | string[] | yes      | Metric API names, e.g. ["activeUsers","sessions","keyEvents","totalRevenue"].                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `dateRanges`      | object[] |          | Up to 4 date ranges. Defaults to the last 28 days (28daysAgo → yesterday).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `dimensionFilter` | object   |          | A GA4 Data API FilterExpression object. Examples:<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"country","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"United States"}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"eventName","inListFilter":{"values":["purchase","sign_up"]}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"sessions","numericFilter":{"operation":"GREATER_THAN","value":{"int64Value":"100"}}}}<br>{"andGroup":{"expressions":[<expr>,<expr>]}} · {"orGroup":{"expressions":[...]}} · {"notExpression":<expr>}<br>stringFilter.matchType: EXACT \| BEGINS_WITH \| ENDS_WITH \| CONTAINS \| FULL_REGEXP \| PARTIAL_REGEXP. Use dimension fields in dimensionFilter and metric fields in metricFilter. |
| `metricFilter`    | object   |          | A GA4 Data API FilterExpression object. Examples:<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"country","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"United States"}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"eventName","inListFilter":{"values":["purchase","sign_up"]}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"sessions","numericFilter":{"operation":"GREATER_THAN","value":{"int64Value":"100"}}}}<br>{"andGroup":{"expressions":[<expr>,<expr>]}} · {"orGroup":{"expressions":[...]}} · {"notExpression":<expr>}<br>stringFilter.matchType: EXACT \| BEGINS_WITH \| ENDS_WITH \| CONTAINS \| FULL_REGEXP \| PARTIAL_REGEXP. Use dimension fields in dimensionFilter and metric fields in metricFilter. |
| `orderBys`        | object[] |          | Sort order, e.g. [{"field":"sessions","desc":true}].                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `limit`           | integer  |          | Max rows to return (default 100; capped by GA4_MCP_MAX_ROWS).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `offset`          | integer  |          | Row offset for paging.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `includeTotals`   | boolean  |          | Also return metric totals across all rows. Default: `false`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| `keepEmptyRows`   | boolean  |          | Default: `false`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `currencyCode`    | string   |          | ISO 4217 code, e.g. "USD". Defaults to the property currency.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## `batch_run_reports`

Run up to 5 reports for one property in a single API call (cheaper and faster than separate run_report calls). Each request takes the same fields as run_report.

| Parameter  | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property` | string   |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |
| `requests` | object[] | yes      |                                                                                                                                                         |

## `run_pivot_report`

Run a pivot (cross-tab) report. Every dimension must appear in exactly one pivot's fieldNames. Example: pivots [{fieldNames:["country"],limit:5},{fieldNames:["deviceCategory"],limit:3}] with metric sessions.

| Parameter         | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`        | string   |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `dimensions`      | string[] | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `metrics`         | string[] | yes      | Metric API names, e.g. ["activeUsers","sessions","keyEvents","totalRevenue"].                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `dateRanges`      | object[] |          | Up to 4 date ranges. Defaults to the last 28 days (28daysAgo → yesterday).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `pivots`          | object[] | yes      |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `dimensionFilter` | object   |          | A GA4 Data API FilterExpression object. Examples:<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"country","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"United States"}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"eventName","inListFilter":{"values":["purchase","sign_up"]}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"sessions","numericFilter":{"operation":"GREATER_THAN","value":{"int64Value":"100"}}}}<br>{"andGroup":{"expressions":[<expr>,<expr>]}} · {"orGroup":{"expressions":[...]}} · {"notExpression":<expr>}<br>stringFilter.matchType: EXACT \| BEGINS_WITH \| ENDS_WITH \| CONTAINS \| FULL_REGEXP \| PARTIAL_REGEXP. ## `run_realtime_report`

Report on events from the last 30 minutes (up to 60 for GA4 360). Realtime supports a limited set of fields, e.g. dimensions country, city, deviceCategory, unifiedScreenName, eventName, minutesAgo; metrics activeUsers, eventCount, keyEvents, screenPageViews.

| Parameter         | Type     | Required | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`        | string   |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| `dimensions`      | string[] |          | Default: `[]`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `metrics`         | string[] | yes      | e.g. ["activeUsers"]                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `dimensionFilter` | object   |          | A GA4 Data API FilterExpression object. Examples:<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"country","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"United States"}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"eventName","inListFilter":{"values":["purchase","sign_up"]}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"sessions","numericFilter":{"operation":"GREATER_THAN","value":{"int64Value":"100"}}}}<br>{"andGroup":{"expressions":[<expr>,<expr>]}} · {"orGroup":{"expressions":[...]}} · {"notExpression":<expr>}<br>stringFilter.matchType: EXACT \| BEGINS_WITH \| ENDS_WITH \| CONTAINS \| FULL_REGEXP \| PARTIAL_REGEXP. Use dimension fields in dimensionFilter and metric fields in metricFilter. |
| `metricFilter`    | object   |          | A GA4 Data API FilterExpression object. Examples:<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"country","stringFilter":{"matchType":"EXACT","value":"United States"}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"eventName","inListFilter":{"values":["purchase","sign_up"]}}}<br>{"filter":{"fieldName":"sessions","numericFilter":{"operation":"GREATER_THAN","value":{"int64Value":"100"}}}}<br>{"andGroup":{"expressions":[<expr>,<expr>]}} · {"orGroup":{"expressions":[...]}} · {"notExpression":<expr>}<br>stringFilter.matchType: EXACT \| BEGINS_WITH \| ENDS_WITH \| CONTAINS \| FULL_REGEXP \| PARTIAL_REGEXP. Use dimension fields in dimensionFilter and metric fields in metricFilter. |
| `orderBys`        | object[] |          | Sort order, e.g. [{"field":"sessions","desc":true}].                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `limit`           | integer  |          | Max rows to return (default 100; capped by GA4_MCP_MAX_ROWS).                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## `list_custom_dimensions`

List a property's custom dimensions (parameter name, display name, scope). In reports they're referenced as customEvent:<param>, customUser:<param> or customItem:<param>.

| Parameter  | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property` | string |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |

## `list_custom_metrics`

List a property's custom metrics (parameter name, display name, unit, scope).

| Parameter  | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property` | string |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |

## `list_key_events`

List a property's key events (formerly called conversions), with counting method and creation time.

| Parameter  | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property` | string |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |

## `list_audiences`

List a property's audiences (uses the v1alpha Admin API). By default returns a summary; set includeDefinitions for full filter clauses.

| Parameter            | Type    | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------------- | ------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`           | string  |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |
| `includeDefinitions` | boolean |          | Default: `false`.                                                                                                                                       |

## `create_custom_dimension` ✍️ _(write — requires `GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true`)_

Create a custom dimension on a property. This changes the GA4 configuration and counts against the property's custom dimension quota. Confirm with the user before calling.

| Parameter                    | Type                        | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`                   | string                      |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |
| `parameterName`              | string                      | yes      | Event/user/item parameter name, e.g. plan_type.                                                                                                         |
| `displayName`                | string                      | yes      |                                                                                                                                                         |
| `scope`                      | `EVENT` \| `USER` \| `ITEM` |          | Default: `"EVENT"`.                                                                                                                                     |
| `description`                | string                      |          |                                                                                                                                                         |
| `disallowAdsPersonalization` | boolean                     |          | USER scope only.                                                                                                                                        |

## `create_custom_metric` ✍️ _(write — requires `GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true`)_

Create an event-scoped custom metric on a property. This changes the GA4 configuration. Confirm with the user before calling.

| Parameter              | Type                                                                                                                             | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`             | string                                                                                                                           |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |
| `parameterName`        | string                                                                                                                           | yes      |                                                                                                                                                         |
| `displayName`          | string                                                                                                                           | yes      |                                                                                                                                                         |
| `measurementUnit`      | `STANDARD` \| `CURRENCY` \| `FEET` \| `METERS` \| `KILOMETERS` \| `MILES` \| `MILLISECONDS` \| `SECONDS` \| `MINUTES` \| `HOURS` |          | Default: `"STANDARD"`.                                                                                                                                  |
| `description`          | string                                                                                                                           |          |                                                                                                                                                         |
| `restrictedMetricType` | `COST_DATA` \| `REVENUE_DATA`[]                                                                                                  |          | Only for CURRENCY metrics.                                                                                                                              |

## `create_key_event` ✍️ _(write — requires `GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true`)_

Mark an event name as a key event (conversion) on a property. Confirm with the user before calling.

| Parameter        | Type                                   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`       | string                                 |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |
| `eventName`      | string                                 | yes      |                                                                                                                                                         |
| `countingMethod` | `ONCE_PER_EVENT` \| `ONCE_PER_SESSION` |          | Default: `"ONCE_PER_EVENT"`.                                                                                                                            |

## `archive_custom_dimension` ✍️ _(write — requires `GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true`)_

Archive (retire) a custom dimension. It stops collecting and disappears from reports; this cannot be undone via the API. Always confirm with the user first.

| Parameter         | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| ----------------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`        | string |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |
| `customDimension` | string | yes      | Numeric ID or parameter name of the custom dimension.                                                                                                   |

## `archive_custom_metric` ✍️ _(write — requires `GA4_MCP_ENABLE_WRITES=true`)_

Archive (retire) a custom metric. It stops collecting and disappears from reports; this cannot be undone via the API. Always confirm with the user first.

| Parameter      | Type   | Required | Description                                                                                                                                             |
| -------------- | ------ | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `property`     | string |          | GA4 property: numeric ID ("123456789"), resource name ("properties/123456789") or display name ("My Website"). Defaults to GA4_DEFAULT_PROPERTY if set. |
| `customMetric` | string | yes      | Numeric ID or parameter name of the custom metric.                                                                                                      |

# Prompts

- **`weekly_traffic_summary`**: Summarise the last 7 days vs. the previous 7 days. Arguments: `property`.
- **`top_landing_pages`**: Find the best and worst performing landing pages. Arguments: `property`, `days`.
- **`channel_performance`**: Compare acquisition channels on volume, engagement and conversion. Arguments: `property`, `days`.
